definitions.window: the same speaker's last 5 messages, in one run: a course for a showing, a production's director, a classmate, a notice's category, the Profile's card
definitions.exact: a message whose kind, title and whole text were all said before in the same run
definitions.openings: a first sentence, with dates, figures, quotes and names taken out, said in the window
definitions.bodies: everything after the first sentence (the part played aside), as structures, said in the window; denominator: messages of more than one sentence
definitions.sameFinding: a repeated body whose message is on the same thing as the one it repeats (the note's key, or the director's note and its problem); said continuing: its first sentence says so (again, still, same, as on, last time, before, back, since, keeps, another, running, in a row)
definitions.structures: a sentence whose structure (dates, figures, quotes, ordinals, counts and runs of capitalised words past the first taken out) was said in the window; allStale: a message every one of whose sentences was
definitions.contradictions: a showing's claims read from its words against the course's showings before it in the run: a band's move named against the last piece, a best against every piece before, a run against the Strong-or-better run, a note's count against the earlier showings on the same note (any course), either order of a day's two on it allowed, since a showing's recorded time is its day's; the claims a phrasing the parser doesn't know makes aren't counted, so each count of claims is its denominator
definitions.events: from notices alone: each classmate's apologies against their Didn't Come notices before them; a miss's and a request's stated count against the notices before
definitions.lastAnswer: a classmate's moment that says how the last of its kind was answered, against the answer the run recorded for the one before it from the same classmate
definitions.excluded: nothing is left out of a denominator but the sentence naming the part played, which every scene's feedback ends on
